ns2:course.label: Analysis of Data
ns2:course.description: Nature of probabilistic models for observed data; discrete and continuous distribution function models; inferences on universe parameters based on sample values; control charts, acceptance sampling, and measurement theory. Credit is not given for both IE 300 and CEE 202. Prerequisite: MATH 241.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both IE 300 and CEE 202. Prerequisite: MATH 241.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: ME and IE students will not receive credit for this course and STAT 400.
